lines.title: ECOA HLT Series Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: High-speed electrohydraulic scissor lifts rated 2,500 to 6,500 lb with lifting heights up to 70 in.
lines.content:
ECOA's HLT Series lift tables are high-speed electrohydraulic scissor lifts built for heavy-duty applications and tough working conditions.

Capacities run from 2,500 to 6,500 lb, with lifting heights up to 70 in., a wide range of platform sizes and options to configure them for specific applications.

lines.title: ECOA HH Series Heavy Duty Lifts
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty electrohydraulic scissor lifts rated 8,000 to 12,000 lb with 36 to 60 in. of travel.
lines.content:
HH Heavy Duty Series lift tables are ECOA's heavy-duty electrohydraulic scissor lifts, designed for demanding applications and tough working conditions.

ECOA rates the series at 8,000 to 12,000 lb, with 36 to 60 in. of travel and platforms from 36 x 48 to 48 x 102 in.
key_features: Platforms from 36 x 48 to 48 x 102 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: ECOA CLT Compact Double Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty double scissor lifts with small platforms and high travel, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
CLT Series lifts are heavy-duty electrohydraulic double scissor lifts that pair small platforms with high travel, for a wide range of applications.

ECOA rates them at 2,000 to 6,000 lb, with 36 to 48 in. of travel and platforms up to 7 ft long.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: ECOA Extended Vertical Travel Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Double, triple and quad scissor lifts for extended travel, with lift heights up to 356 in.
lines.content:
ECOA's extended vertical travel lifts stack two, three or four scissor mechanisms for heavy-duty applications that need to reach high. DSL double scissor lifts are rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb with lift heights up to 162 in.

TSL triple scissor lifts are rated 3,000 to 6,000 lb with lift heights up to 222 in., and QSL quad scissor lifts are rated 3,000 to 6,000 lb with lift heights up to 356 in., about 24 ft of travel.
key_features: Double, triple and quad scissor designs
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: ECOA Magnum Super Heavy Duty Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Super heavy-duty scissor lifts rated 15,000 lb up to 120,000 lb in single, double long, double wide and quad configurations.
lines.content:
The Magnum range is ECOA's super heavy-duty electrohydraulic scissor lifts. MLT single lifts are rated 15,000 to 30,000 lb, with 30 to 72 in. of travel and platforms from 48 x 60 to 72 x 132 in.

MLTDL double long and MLTDW double wide lifts are rated 25,000 to 60,000 lb, and MLTQD double wide, double long lifts are rated 50,000 to 120,000 lb with platforms up to 120 x 264 in. Platforms can be sized to fit the application.
key_features: Single, double long, double wide and quad configurations
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables
